start2.title: Story
start2.text:
You were born and raised in a settlement built around a conquered ant hill. Most residents here are hunters and craftsmen, and they feed themselves by hunting monsters, as farming techniques have long been lost here.

You, having neither the courage to hunt nor the skills to craft, have become a scout.

start3.title: Story
start3.text:
Every day, you wake up early in the morning and patrol the nearby area to notify the settlement of any dangers or things to scavenge.

This is a dangerous job. Many scouts disappear without a trace every week. Like any scout, you must carry a weapon around at all times, even if you don't have the courage to fight. Your weapon of choice was...

startrange.title: Story
startrange.text:
You carry around a ranged weapon in case there is something weak that you can hunt from outside danger's reach.

Your ranged weapon of choice was...

startmelee.title: Story
startmelee.text:
You carry around a melee weapon to prepare for the worst case scenario of being ambushed by one of the many dangerous predators near the hill.

Your melee weapon of choice was...

ant hill.title: Ant Hill
ant hill.text:
It is %time.

You are now at the hilly streets of Ant Hill.
The streets are crowded with people walking around trying to buy meat from the hunter shops. Near the top of the hill you see the barred entrance to the underground where residents take shelter during the night.

ant hill underground.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill underground.text:
You open the barred gate and enter the underground section of the settlement.

It is mostly dark, and the only light sources here are from domesticated fireflies that people herd around. You wander through the familiar dirt maze.

ant hill home.title: Home
ant hill home.text:
You arrive at your dormitory. Your roommates greet you.

You sit on your hammock talking to your roommates about hunting ants when you hear people shouting and running in the halls. It sounds like there is something going on on the surface...

ant hill ambushed.title: Ant Hill
ant hill ambushed.text:
You run outside to see the streets raided by the infamous Wolf spiders.
You see people getting kidnapped and dragged away.

Your cowardly roommates run back inside. There are hunters with weapons beside you, but they just guard the entrance, not daring to go out to the streets to help the people.

You see a girl getting dragged off by a wolf spider, screaming.

opt.to:
>encounter>wolf spiders>ant hill kidnapped>>save>spider>1>>save>temp>

Scobby: [I heard what you went through. I don't know what you were thinking... but it's not common to see people come back from the spider forest, so there must be something in you.]

>ant hill aftermath

opt.text: Run back inside. The spiders are as big as you are.

ant hill ambushed skip.title: Home
ant hill ambushed skip.text: It's probably nothing... Even if it was, you'll hear it from someone else later. You lay down on your hammock and rest while all your roommates leave to find out what's going on. You fall asleep like a champion.

ant hill aftermath.title: Home
ant hill aftermath.text:
It's %time.

The bustling movements and tension in the air fades.
You hear that about 7 people were kidnapped away by the spiders today. All services are closed.

ant hill kidnapped.title: Kidnapped
ant hill kidnapped.text:
You hear a stranger's voice.

Stranger: [Hey, wake up!]

You open your eyes but don't see anything. It is pitch black.

Stranger: [You've been sleeping like a baby. What's wrong with you?]

Suddenly, a light appears from nowhere and you instinctively turn your head to protect your eye.
It is a faint light cast with magic! You look at the stranger with envy.

Spellcaster: [We've been kidnapped by the wolf spiders a few hours ago. There are 8 of us and we're going to make a run for it, before they eat us one by one.]

spider death.text: You fall back asleep while the 7 of the abductees make a run for it. Hours passed, and one of the hungry spiders kill and eat you while you are asleep.

opt.text: I made the wrong choice, I guess...

runaway.title: Kidnapped
runaway.text:
You start making a run through the maze like tunnels. The underground tunnel you are in looks similar to the underground Ant Hill, except the tunnels are larger and there are spiderweb cocoons on the walls.

You and the abductees keep running until you reach the exit blocked by leaves and spiderwebs. There are lights coming in from outside and the spellcaster stops his magic.

Spellcaster: [That's the way out. This underground tunnel seems like their storage area where they keep the food fresh, which means there is a good chance that some of the spiders are nearby.

You are a scout, right? Why don't you go outside and take a look for us?]

runaway1-1.title: Kidnapped
runaway1-1.text:
Spellcaster: [Are you serious? fine, I guess I'll have to do this myself.]

The spellcaster takes out his knife. He slashes through the spiderwebs and crawls outside.
You hear one of the other abductees behind you call you a coward.

A minute passed, and you hear the spellcaster scream from outside.

runaway2.title: Kidnapped
runaway2.text:
You crawl outside and see people in rags wielding weapons. You don't recognize any of them.
You crawl back inside and tell everyone.

Spellcaster: [They must be ferals. We should wait for them to pass then sneak out.]

Abductee: [Ferals? There's no such thing here! They must be others kidnapped here from Ant Hill!]

runaway2-1.title: Kidnapped
runaway2-1.text: You wait with the others for a few minutes until outside is clear, then make a run for it.

runaway2-2.title: Kidnapped
runaway2-2.text:
You follow the abductee outside.

Abductee: [Hey, over here!]

The people in rags start throwing stuff at him.

Abductee: [Oh, shit!]

runaway1-2.title: Kidnapped
runaway1-2.text: You and the abductees peek outside and see the spellcaster being attacked by several people in rags. They point at your group and shout.

runaway2-2-1.title: Kidnapped
runaway2-2-1.text:
You take down the feral human and look around. It looks like all of the ferals have gone down, but 4 people are dead as a result, one of them being the spellcaster.
You dig through his belongings and find a map.

You look down at one of the feral humans and notice that they don't look particularly starved. They are wearing rags, but in rather clean condition.

One of the critically wounded feral woman opens her eyes slowly looks up. She stares at you with pleasing eyes and whimpers.
You try to communicate with her but she does not seem to understand you.
The other abductees decide to just abandon her and leave the spider forest before the wolf spiders return. You follow.

ant hill outskirt.title: Return to Ant Hill
ant hill outskirt.text:
Your group finally arrive at the Ant Hill after about an hour of walk.

People come out to meet and greet. Families of the lost ones grieve. Some thank you for getting out there to try to fight the beasts.

You return to your roommates and share your fascinating stories...

ant hill spellcaster.title: Return to Ant Hill
ant hill spellcaster.text:
You find the spellcaster in the underground temple talking to the priest.

Spellcaster: [Ah, it's you. I forgot to thank you for your help back in the woods. My name is Lucid. Are you doing ok?]

ant hill spellcaster2.title: Return to Ant Hill
ant hill spellcaster2.text:
Spellcaster: [Ah, of course. I was just talking to the priest here about teaching the people of Ant Hill some spellcasting. You are welcome to join the session!]

Priest: [I heard what you did out there. It wasn't the brightest decision to try to fight the spiders, but you seem to have brought good luck in the end. I need some time with Lucid right now, why don't you come back another time?]

ant hill next week.title: Home
ant hill next week.text:
It's been a week since the kidnapping incident. People went back to their normal lives, as death and disappearances aren't uncommon in Ant Hill.

One of the hunters let you know that the high priest is looking for you.

ant hill temple.title: Ant Hill Temple
ant hill temple.text:
You walk into the Gaia's Temple, which is a rather large room among the many rooms in the dirt maze. There is an altar made of strange light blue stone in the center and two fireflies by the altar shines the room.
On the bench at the corner of the room you spot Scobby, a veteran hunter of Ant Hill, and Cheese, son of the priest.%temp
The priest dressed in white robe comes out from the back to greet you.

Priest: [Welcome. As you may have guessed, you and Scobby have been selected for this month's Full Moon's Journey.]

ant hill temple1.title: Ant Hill Temple
ant hill temple1.text:
Priest: [As you may well know, we have not been successful in communicating with the outside world for the past 5 years.]

Priest: [That has changed. A foreign visitor named Lucid hailing from the city of Jericho is among us right now. He drew us a map leading all the way to Jericho.]

Lucid: [Hello.]

The priest hands you a copy of the map drawn on a scroll.

Priest: [Like I said earlier, we had selected Scobby here for the mission to the outside, and you as his assistant. This time, we are sending you to Jericho. Lucid wrote us a letter that might get us help from the city.]

Priest: [This city lies across the river, close to the Stone Henge, our old neighbor. No one sent there has come back so far, but if you can somehow get to Jericho, you won't have to worry about your way back.]

Priest: [And... my son will accompany you as our liaison to Jericho. I know I may be burdening you with this, but please try your best. Don't prioritize taking care of him. Reaching the city comes first, always.]

Cheese: [What are you saying, father? Why do you always make me look bad?]

Priest: [...Anyways, we will hold a great feast tomorrow to celebrate Lucid's arrival and your departure.]

You see Lucid lost in thought with a strange, worried look on his face.

ant hill temple2.title: Ant Hill Temple
ant hill temple2.text:
Priest: [As you may well know, we have not been successful in communicating with the outside world for the past 5 years.]

Priest: [I believe that some day, we will find the ones who will finally complete the Full Moon's Journey and prove themselves a hero of Ant Hill.]

Priest: [Also... my son will accompany you on the trip. I know I may be burdening you with this, but please try your best. Don't prioritize taking care of him. Reaching the city comes first, always.]

Cheese: [What are you saying, father? Why do you always make me look bad?]

Priest: [... Anyways, we will hold a feast for your departure tomorrow so you can say your good byes to your folks. Always remember that you are carrying out one of the most honorable deeds for Ant Hill.]
